metadata.title: Cody White - Nursing ankle issue
metadata.description: White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.
metadata.analysis: It's not clear when White picked up the injury, but that he got in some activity at practice Wednesday suggests it's probably not overly serious. As long as he can upgrade to full participation Thursday or Friday, there's a solid chance he'll be able to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

metadata.title: Cody White (ankle) limited participant Wednesday
metadata.description: Cody White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: White was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, though he's still being bothered by an ankle issue. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 5, but we won't know for sure until later in the week.

metadata.title: Cody White A Potential Waiver Wire Contributor After Nailor Injury
metadata.description: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White could see more opportunities in the passing game after Raiders WR2 Jalen Nailor (head) left his team's Week 4 contest with a concussion. Players with that injury typically miss at least one game while in the league's concussion protocol -- his absence would move White up to the second receiver spot, behind WR1 Tre Tucker. There isn't a lot of talent separating any of Vegas' pass-catchers this season, and White scored two touchdown in Week 2 and one in Week 3, so he could produce well when given more targets. He hasn't been very involved in the offense so far, as tight end Brock Bowers is the clear No. 1 pass-catcher and White was relatively unknown before this season started. A higher target share could see him become a starter in deep leagues. Outside of those deep leagues, he's probably not worth rostering, but in dynasty leagues and redraft leagues with 14 or more teams, any player with a reasonable chance at being productive should be rostered.

metadata.title: Cody White - Two catches in loss
metadata.description: White caught two of four targets for 36 yards during Sunday's 30-27 loss to Kansas City.
metadata.analysis: White failed to make it three games in a row with a touchdown, but his 36 receiving yards and four targets were new season highs for the wideout. The 27-year-old has now caught five of 10 targets for 64 yards and three touchdowns over four contests to open the 2026 campaign. White was already slotted in as the team's No. 3 wide receiver with Jack Bech (forearm) on injured reserve, but he could operate in an even more prominent role Week 5 against New England after No. 2 option Jalen Nailor suffered a concussion Sunday.

metadata.title: Cody White Still a Risky Play Despite Touchdown Streak
metadata.description: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White has been an unexpected bright spot amid the team's 3-0 start to the season, contributing three touchdowns over the last two weeks. However, despite the scoring streak, he's still not a reliable fantasy option for Week 4 against the Kansas City Chiefs. All three of White's catches this season have gone for touchdowns; this 100% touchdown rate is absolutely not sustainable. Something has to give, and right now, he's more likely to see his touchdown volume decrease rather than see his target volume increase. With a sub-22% snap share in all three of his games, White's fantasy outlook is entirely dependent on him scoring a touchdown. Even last week, when he scored a touchdown, he finished with a modest 7.6 fantasy points in PPR leagues, because the touchdown was his only catch. We might see his snap share increase with Jack Bech (forearm) on injured reserve, but he's still behind Jalen Nailor, Tre Tucker, and potentially Dareke Young on the depth chart. Managers looking for a receiver with touchdown upside should head the waiver wire for better options with higher volume shares. It's also worth noting that he has an incredibly challenging matchup against the Chiefs, who have allowed the fewest fantasy points to wide receivers in 2026.

metadata.title: Cody White - Gets spot on active roster
metadata.description: The Raiders signed White from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: White began the campaign on Las Vegas' practice squad but has already been elevated for game day the maximum three times. He's collected three catches on six targets for 28 yards, with all three receptions going for touchdowns. Jack Bech (forearm) landed on injured reserve Tuesday, and White could immediately take Bech's role as the Raiders' No. 3 wide receiver.

metadata.title: Cody White Could Immediately Gain Starting Role
metadata.description: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White was signed from the practice squad to the active roster on Tuesday. White began the year on the practice squad, but he has already been elevated for game day a maximum of three times. White could now immediately slide into a starting role with Jack Bech (forearm) heading to the Injured Reserve on Tuesday. Through three games, White has recorded three receptions for 28 yards and three touchdowns. He could be an interesting deep league pickup with the Raiders banged up at wide receiver. He's looking like a touchdown-dependent option against the New Orleans Saints in Week 4.

metadata.title: Cody White - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: White reverted to the Raiders' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: White played 15 offensive snaps in Sunday's win over the Saints and again secured a touchdown, reeling in a four-yard score from Kirk Cousins. White has three catches over the last two weeks, and all three have resulted in red-zone touchdowns. With Jack Bech sidelined with a broken forearm, White could play an elevated role moving forward behind Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor at wide receiver.

metadata.title: Cody White catches touchdown Sunday
metadata.description: Cody White caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: White now has three touchdowns in the past two weeks coming off the practice squad. Still be remains off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Cody White - Returns to active roster
metadata.description: The Raiders elevated White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.
metadata.analysis: The Raiders have elected to utilize White's last practice squad elevation, allowing the team to carry the wide receiver into game day for each of the first three weeks of the regular season. White caught two touchdowns on two targets for a total of 24 yards in the Raiders' Week 2 win over the Chargers, leaving a strong impression in his seven offensive snaps. The 27-year-old also provides strong value on special teams, making it likely White will be first in line for a 53-man roster spot if one were to open up.

metadata.title: Cody White Elevated to Raiders Active Roster for Week 3
metadata.description: The Las Vegas Raiders have elevated wide receiver Cody White from their practice squad to their active roster ahead of the team's Week 3 matchup against the New Orleans Saints, per Ryan McFadden of ESPN. White had a big game in Week 2 against the Los Angeles Chargers, recording two catches for 24 yards and two touchdowns on two targets. Las Vegas has elevated White for all three of their games so far this season, which means that the team will need to sign him to the active roster for him to be eligible to play in Week 4. The 27-year-old White has appeared in 32 games across five NFL seasons. However, there could be an opportunity for him to carve out a regular role with the Raiders if he continues to perform. It's too early for fantasy managers to target White on the waiver wire, but he could be a name to monitor in deeper leagues if he shows well in Week 3.

metadata.title: Cody White reverts back to Raiders practice squad
metadata.description: Cody White reverted back to the Raiders practice squad.
metadata.analysis: White caught two touchdowns last week. He could be elevated again soon.

metadata.title: Cody White - Returns to practice squad
metadata.description: White reverted to the Raiders' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
metadata.analysis: White was elevated to the active roster for a second straight week, and he was able to reel in a pair of touchdown catches during Sunday's 26-14 victory over the Chargers. The wide receiver has played 18 offensive snaps over two games with Las Vegas so far this year, and he'll likely be elevated again Week 3 versus the Saints.

metadata.title: Cody White hauls in two touchdowns Sunday
metadata.description: Cody White caught two passes for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
metadata.analysis: The Raiders were able to score a lot of points on offense on Sunday. White made a couple big plays for them on that front, catching two touchdowns in the team's win over the Chargers. This was a pretty good game for him but he isn't expected to be a fantasy relevant wideout for a while.

metadata.title: Cody White - Surprises with pair of TDs in Week 2
metadata.description: White caught both of his targets for 24 yards and two touchdowns in the Raiders' 26-14 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: White was elevated from the practice squad Saturday for the second straight week to begin the season. He played just seven offensive snaps against Los Angeles on Sunday but made the most of his limited chances, securing 11- and 13-yard touchdowns from Kirk Cousins in the second half. White is unlikely to recreate the magic going forward, as his seven pass routes were a distant fourth among Raiders wideouts, trailing Tre Tucker, Jack Bech and Jalen Nailor at the position.

metadata.title: Cody White - Elevated to active roster again
metadata.description: The Raiders elevated White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: White is poised to play his second consecutive game for the Raiders as a depth wide receiver. With Dont'e Thornton (undisclosed), Justin Shorter (undisclosed) and Corey Rucker (undisclosed) all on IR through Week 4 at the least, White will likely continue to suit up on game day until he is out of elevations. White played 11 offensive snaps and 14 special-teams snaps in the Raiders' Week 1 win over the Dolphins but was unable to catch his only target in the contest.

metadata.title: Cody White - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: White reverted to the Raiders' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: White failed to catch his only target in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Dolphins. The wide receiver played 11 of the 68 offensive snaps for the team, but added another 14 reps on special teams as a utility player, recording three tackles on kick coverage.

metadata.title: Cody White sees one target in Week 1
metadata.description: Cody White failed to catch his only target in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: White was an afterthought in the Las Vegas passing attack, finishing last on the team in targets in the win. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats until further notice ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Cody White - Elevated for Sunday
metadata.description: The Raiders elevated White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: White is set to suit up for the Raiders because the team has three wide receivers currently on injured reserve. Dont'e Thornton (undisclosed), Justin Shorter (undisclosed) and Corey Rucker (undisclosed) all must miss at least four games, allowing White to show out as a valuable depth option for the receiving corps and special teams unit.

metadata.title: Cody White - New opportunity with Las Vegas
metadata.description: White signed with the Raiders' practice squad Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: White appeared in 10 regular-season games for the Seahawks in 2025 but was released by the defending Super Bowl champions Sunday after failing to make the team's 53-man roster. He'll get a fresh opportunity with Las Vegas, and he would be a candidate for an elevation to the active roster if the Raiders need a pass catcher who can also contribute on special teams.

metadata.title: Cody White Leads Seahawks in Receiving on Friday
metadata.description: Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Cody White hauled in three passes for 69 yards on Friday against the Kansas City Chiefs. White has been with Seattle since 2023, primarily in a special teams capacity. His services will likely be necessary with Jake Bobo (knee) done for the season. His performance on Friday was encouraging for his chances to make the team. Given his role on special teams, he should be a part of the Seahawks' equation for the coming season. He should be nowhere near fantasy rosters, but White's potential presence on the roster will be interesting to see how it affects the ability of talented young players such as Emmanuel Henderson Jr. and Montorie Foster Jr. to make the active roster.
